validate_task_spec.task_title: Task 7: Ask for a missing ZIP
validate_task_spec.goal: The bot asks for a missing ZIP code.
acceptance_criteria: The bot asks for the ZIP code in 100% of runs when the ZIP field is empty.
The ZIP mapper never writes a ZIP that is not five digits.
validate_task_spec.context: The model writes the question from the prompt; the mapper is deterministic Kotlin.
boundary_rules: Code checks structured data only. It never inspects reply or user words: no regex, phrase or keyword matching over them. Exception: STOP and HELP are matched in code, as carrier rules require.
The LLM writes every reply. The only code-written text is verbatim legal text.
